article_content: Toulon's owner, Mourad Boudjellal, has apologized for the ugly scenes that occurred during Sunday's match against Leicester. The incident involved Toulon player Martin Castrogiovanni, who launched a personal attack on Leicester's director of rugby, Richard Cockerill. There are also unconfirmed allegations that former England full-back Delon Armitage threatened a Leicester supporter.
translated_content: Tõloni omanik, Mourad Boudjellal, on vabandanud keeldud Leicester'le vastuksuse parastamise toosetulemuste, mis juhtus toimus Touloni mängu Martin Castrogiovanni, kes ründas isikus personaalselt rünnaku Leicester'i ragbipallidirektori Richard Cockerilli vastu. Samuti on kahtlus, et on olemas Delon Armitage olevatud ohtust Leicester'i toetaja.
